verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission crew completed a 10-day flight around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Four astronauts embarked on a 10-day mission'; R3: 'orbit the Moon on a 10-day mission'; R4: '10-day mission around the moon'; R9: 'Mission duration 9 days, 1 hour... lunar flyby'; R10: '10-day mission around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the mission was a 10-day lunar flyby/orbit completed by the crew.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission crew splashed down on April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'splashed down ... at 5:07 p.m. local time Friday [April 10 context]'; R9: 'Landing date April 11, 2026, 00:07:27 UTC (April 10, 5:07:27 p.m. PDT)'; R10: 'splash down ... April 10, 2026'; R11: 'splashed down ... at 8:07 p.m. ET [April 10]'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm splashdown on April 10, 2026, in local/PDT time, matching the claim precisely.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission crew included NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch'; R3: 'NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Hammock Koch'; R9: 'Members: Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch'
verifications.reasoning: Nearly all sources explicitly list these exact NASA astronauts as part of the Artemis II crew.
